ParallelEnv branches agent execution into parallel environment snapshots with beam/priority scheduling, and credits tree-forking for the gain (runner-up planning_and_control_flow); SWE-bench Pro run.

MUR allocates thinking budget to critical steps from momentum uncertainty, with gamma-control tuning the budget; new training-free method tested on MATH-500, AIME24/25 and GPQA-diamond.
